relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a de novo TNFAIP3 variant: 'the heterozygous substitution NM_006290.3:c.1084C > T was found'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in my scratch directory only assembled the JSON and resolved each span to the exact paper characters (the paper uses thin and four-per-em spaces, e.g. in 'c.1084C > T' and 'CRP was 113 mg/L'). In scope: the patient; both parents (tested negative for the variant; migraine in both; gestational diabetes in the mother); two previously published children from reference (8) ('a 3-year-old and a 6-month-old child with HA20'), included under the v4 passing-mention rule because ages are given; no TNFAIP3 variant is printed for them in the text, so they have no variant rows, and the sentence 'the concentration of serum IgG was elevated as it was also in our patient' does not say which ref (8) child, so it was not recorded. Their 'normal lymphocyte percentages' row is a statement about both children together (evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'). Group-level counts from refs (4) and (6) describe no individuals and were not extracted. Onset: the case presentation says 'Fevers started at 7 weeks of age' while the Discussion says fever attacks 'since early infancy, from the age of 2 years old'; onset recorded as 7 weeks from the Case presentation. Checklist: 'no rash' and 'no arthritis' were not used to exclude the composite items (skin lesions; arthritis or arthralgia); muscle pains are myalgia, not arthralgia. ANA negative alone was not used to exclude 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)'. Ileal 'lymphatic hypertrophy' was not mapped to lymphoproliferation (left not reported). GI inflammation marked observed from histology ('non-specific mild inflammatory changes'), although ultrasound and MR enterography showed no signs of inflammation and endoscopy was otherwise normal. Endoscopy 'investigation was normal' and 'Infections were excluded' were not turned into specific excluded features. Variant type 'nonsense' is from the authors' statement that the variant changes glutamine 362 into a termination codon. Table 2 of the paper repeats cells across rows (likely a merged-cell conversion); only its first row was quoted. Vital status 'alive' rests on the statement that growth and development are so far normal under ongoing follow-up.
